name: MCP Auth Plugin
description: Injects per-agent MCP tools with API key auth and per-sender user_id on every call.

upstreamUrl.description: Default base URL for MCP servers (without user_id). Can be overridden per server.

defaultAuthHeader.description: Default auth header name. Defaults to x-api-key.

agents.description: Per-agent config keyed by agent ID.

mcpServers.description: One or more MCP servers available to this agent. Tools from all servers are merged.

apiKey.description: API key for static auth. Required unless oauth2 is configured.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 Authorization Code + PKCE auth (MCP spec 2025-03). When set, apiKey/authHeader are ignored and Bearer tokens are negotiated against the MCP server's authorization server.

redirectUri.description: OAuth2 redirect_uri. Must match a URI registered with the IdP.

clientId.description: Pre-registered client_id. When set, dynamic registration is skipped (e.g. DemoQueryApp Cloud's 'demo_query_app-mcp-client').

callbackPort.description: Port for the plugin's built-in callback listener. Omit to require manual code submission via the submit_code tool.

authorizationEndpoint.description: Override for the browser-facing authorization endpoint. Use when the MCP host's /oauth/authorize is network-gated but redirects to a public IdP page (e.g. DemoQueryApp Cloud's https://demoquerycloud.dev/auth/oauth2/authorize). Token exchange still uses the discovered token_endpoint.

senderUserMap.description: Maps Slack sender IDs to MCP server user IDs (appended as ?user_id=...).

defaultUserId.description: Fallback user_id when sender is not in senderUserMap. Also used for tool discovery.

toolPrefix.description: Optional prefix added to tool names from this server (e.g. 'connector' → 'mcp_auth__connector__search'). Use to avoid collisions when multiple servers share tool names.

upstreamUrl.label: Upstream MCP URL
upstreamUrl.help: Base URL of the MCP server (Streamable HTTP transport).

defaultAuthHeader.label: Default Auth Header
defaultAuthHeader.help: Header name for API key auth. Default: x-api-key.

agents.label: Per-agent Config
agents.help: MCP server lists and Slack→user_id mappings per agent.
